svg.title: AI inside the Db2 database
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Db2 keeps vectors beside your transactions, with DiskANN vector indexing for similarity search. New SQL functions, TO_EMBEDDING and TEXT_GENERATION, call registered models inside the database. AI-powered optimization analyzes workloads and automates performance tuning.
